_comment: Request template for the affiliate portal's internal short-link API (cookie mode). Replace the placeholder URL with the real endpoint captured from your own browser: DevTools -> Network -> generate a short link with a subID -> Copy as cURL -> run: node tools/trace-portal-link.js --capture '<cURL>' --out portal-link.template.json. Placeholders: {{originUrl}} (Shopee URL to shorten), {{subIds}} (JSON array, up to 5), {{subIdsCsv}} (comma list), {{cookie}} (SHOPEE_COOKIE), {{csrfToken}} (SHOPEE_CSRF_TOKEN). See docs/reverse-engineering/06-portal-short-link.md.
name: portal-short-link
